page.home.title: CHALET | Deluxe office mansions on historic Pyatnitskaya Street
page.home.description: A private collection of premium office units at 40 Pyatnitskaya Street, with terraces, wellness facilities and underground parking.
page.home.s0.h0:
DELUXE OFFICE MANSIONS
on historic Pyatnitskaya Street
page.home.s0.p1: Entrance interiors by the fashion house
page.home.s0.alt0: Architectural rendering of the Chalet office mansions on Pyatnitskaya Street
page.home.s1.h0: Your private venue for business receptions on historic Pyatnitskaya Street
page.home.s1.p2: An intimate, secure setting with controlled access
page.home.s1.p6: Spa, 15-metre pool, hammam, sauna, fitness studio and restaurant.
page.home.s1.p7: Underground parking and a private courtyard
page.home.s1.p8: 22 parking spaces, bespoke landscaping and complete security
page.home.s1.p10: Entrance lobbies and a gallery by the Valentin Yudashkin fashion house
page.home.s2.p0: The mansions are linked by an underground level with mechanised parking.
page.home.s2.p1: Two retail units on two levels, each with its own lift and loading area, fronting the street (a restaurant and a café)
page.home.s2.p3: Single-level premium office units with private terraces
page.home.s2.p4: Office units with double-height spaces and ceilings up to 7 metres
page.home.s2.p5: The unique de luxe offices at Pyatnitskaya 40 Chalet are located on Pyatnitskaya Street, where a new “Golden Mile” is taking shape, with the potential to rival Ostozhenka, one of Moscow’s most prestigious and expensive districts. The ensemble at 40 Pyatnitskaya is complemented by the neighbouring mansion, home to the Valentin Yudashkin fashion house’s flagship three-storey boutique and café.
page.home.s2.p6: Pyatnitskaya Street is in Moscow’s historic centre and is a landmark of Zamoskvorechye. The Tretyakov Gallery, architectural landmarks and heritage buildings attract visitors for walks and shopping.
page.home.s3.h0: Distinctive architecture by the international practice Ginzburg Architects
page.home.s3.p0: Amenities at Pyatnitskaya 40 Chalet include mechanised parking with a car lift, a 15-metre swimming pool, sauna and hammam, fitness and spa facilities, and studios for exercise and yoga.
page.home.s4.p0: 22 parking spaces and 10 storage units on the underground levels
page.about.title: About the project | Chalet Pyatnitskaya 40
page.about.description: Discover Chalet: two private office mansions at 40 Pyatnitskaya Street, a collection of 10 units, wellness amenities and underground parking.
page.about.s0.h0: CHALET. Premium offices — your private venue for business receptions
page.about.s0.p0: Chalet at 40 Pyatnitskaya offers a fresh, luxurious and progressive approach to private office space, fundamentally different from anything else on the market.
page.about.s0.p1: We believe that a property created for negotiations and business can and should reflect its owner’s high status, distinctive personality and taste, while also providing a quiet haven where you alone can enjoy exceptional comfort and privacy.
page.about.s0.alt0: Aerial view of the Chalet complex
page.about.s1.p0: Chalet is a detached, guarded complex in a quiet location in the prestigious historic setting of Pyatnitskaya Street. It comprises two mansions connected by two underground levels that house mechanised parking.
page.about.s1.p2: — 6 single-level premium office units, including 2 with private terraces
page.about.s1.p3: — 2 office units with double-height spaces and ceilings up to 7 metres
page.about.s1.p4: — 2 retail units on two levels (restaurants), each with its own lift and loading area, fronting Pyatnitskaya Street
page.about.s2.p0: Pyatnitskaya 40 Chalet is the most expensive boutique office project on this iconic Moscow street, with no equivalent today. Its privacy and amenities are comparable to deluxe residential developments. It is the first office space of its class where the infrastructure directly shapes quality of life.
page.about.s2.p1: Everything here is designed around convenience, saving time and looking after your health. A spa with a 15-metre pool, sauna and hammam offers a restorative break during the working day. A gym with personal training and a yoga studio help maintain balance even with a busy schedule, supporting productivity.
page.about.s2.p2: The restaurant and café provide spaces for meetings and relaxation, along with food delivery to offices and meeting rooms when every minute matters. A landscaped private courtyard offers a sense of tranquillity and privacy rarely found in central Moscow.
page.about.s2.p3: Chalet sets a new standard for a private club-style office environment, where attentive service, comfort and wellbeing become part of everyday work.

page.parking.title: Two-level underground parking | Chalet 40
page.parking.description: 22 parking spaces and 10 storage units at Chalet 40. Explore the two underground levels, plans, availability and prices.
page.parking.s0.p0: 22 parking spaces and 10 storage units on the underground levels
page.parking.s1.h0: All lifts provide access to the parking levels
page.parking.s1.p0: Two underground parking levels. Chalet’s basement levels are designed as a private, self-contained space, with personal access passes, round-the-clock security and cameras on every level.
page.parking.s2.p0: Larger spaces are designed for those who value freedom of movement and do not want to worry about every centimetre.
page.parking.s2.p1: Open the boot, take your time getting out and avoid touching the next car. Each space is designed to accommodate a large SUV or executive saloon without encroaching on the drive aisle.
page.parking.s2.p2: 22 parking spaces: — 7 compact (13.25 sq m) — 6 standard (14.31–17.92 sq m) — 9 larger spaces (23–26.5 sq m)
page.parking.s3.h0: Fast EV charging on every parking level
page.parking.s3.p0: While the car charges, visitors can use the comfortable waiting room.
page.parking.s3.p1: Or put belongings into storage. Each storage unit on level −2 is sold separately: a private, enclosed space for everything you would rather keep out of sight.
page.parking.s3.alt0: Electric vehicle charging in the parking area
page.parking.s4.p0: A car lift replaces the ramp. Drive onto the platform and the lift takes your car to the required level. No tight corners and no scratched supercar bumpers.

privacy.block1: This personal data processing policy has been prepared in accordance with Federal Law No. 152-FZ of 27 July 2006 “On Personal Data” (the Personal Data Law). It sets out the procedure for processing personal data and the measures taken to ensure its security by Khaytek Development Limited Liability Company (the Operator).
privacy.block2: 1.1. The Operator regards respect for human and civil rights and freedoms when processing personal data, including the rights to privacy and personal and family confidentiality, as its primary objective and a prerequisite for its activities.
privacy.block3: 1.2. This policy of the Operator concerning the processing of personal data (the Policy) applies to all information that the Operator may obtain about visitors to hitdev.ru/.
privacy.block4: 2. Key terms used in this Policy
privacy.block5: 2.1. Automated processing of personal data means processing personal data using computing equipment.
privacy.block6: 2.2. Blocking personal data means temporarily suspending its processing, except where processing is necessary to clarify the data.
privacy.block7: 2.3. Website means the collection of graphic and informational materials, computer programs and databases that make them available online at hitdev.ru/.
privacy.block8: 2.4. Personal data information system means the collection of personal data contained in databases and the information technologies and technical equipment used to process it.
privacy.block9: 2.5. Depersonalisation of personal data means actions that make it impossible, without additional information, to establish whether personal data belongs to a particular User or another personal data subject.
privacy.block10: 2.6. Processing personal data means any action or set of actions performed on personal data, with or without automation, including collection, recording, organisation, accumulation, storage, clarification (updating or amendment), retrieval, use, transfer (dissemination, provision or access), depersonalisation, blocking, erasure and destruction.
privacy.block11: 2.7. Operator means a public authority, municipal authority, legal entity or individual that, independently or jointly with others, organises and/or processes personal data and determines the purposes of processing, the personal data to be processed and the actions performed on it.
privacy.block12: 2.8. Personal data means any information relating directly or indirectly to an identified or identifiable User of hitdev.ru/.
privacy.block13: 2.9. Personal data authorised by its subject for dissemination means personal data to which an unlimited number of persons has access with the subject’s consent to processing personal data authorised for dissemination, given in accordance with the Personal Data Law (personal data authorised for dissemination).
privacy.block14: 2.10. User means any visitor to hitdev.ru/.
privacy.block15: 2.11. Provision of personal data means actions intended to disclose personal data to a specified person or a specified group of persons.
privacy.block16: 2.12. Dissemination of personal data means actions intended to disclose personal data to an unlimited number of persons, transfer such data or make it accessible to an unlimited number of persons, including publication in the media, placement on information and telecommunications networks or provision of access by any other means.
privacy.block17: 2.13. Cross-border transfer of personal data means transferring personal data to a foreign state’s territory, to a foreign public authority, foreign individual or foreign legal entity.
privacy.block18: 2.14. Destruction of personal data means actions that permanently destroy personal data so that its contents cannot be recovered in a personal data information system and/or destroy the physical media containing it.
privacy.block19: 3. Main rights and obligations of the Operator
privacy.block20: 3.1. The Operator has the right to:
privacy.block21: — obtain reliable information and/or documents containing personal data from the personal data subject;
privacy.block22: — continue processing personal data without the subject’s consent, on the grounds specified in the Personal Data Law, if the subject withdraws consent or requests that processing cease;
privacy.block23: — independently determine the measures necessary and sufficient to fulfil the obligations established by the Personal Data Law and regulations adopted under it, unless otherwise provided by that Law or other federal laws.
privacy.block25: — provide personal data subjects, upon request, with information concerning the processing of their personal data;
privacy.block26: — organise personal data processing in accordance with the applicable legislation of the Russian Federation;
privacy.block27: — respond to enquiries and requests from personal data subjects and their legal representatives in accordance with the Personal Data Law;
privacy.block28: — provide the competent personal data protection authority, upon its request, with the necessary information within 10 days of receiving the request;
privacy.block29: — publish this Policy or otherwise ensure unrestricted access to it;
privacy.block30: — take legal, organisational and technical measures to protect personal data against unlawful or accidental access, destruction, alteration, blocking, copying, provision, dissemination and other unlawful actions;
privacy.block31: — cease transferring personal data (dissemination, provision or access), cease processing and destroy personal data in the manner and circumstances prescribed by the Personal Data Law;
privacy.block32: — fulfil other obligations established by the Personal Data Law.
privacy.block33: 4. Main rights and obligations of personal data subjects
privacy.block34: 4.1. Personal data subjects have the right to:
privacy.block35: — obtain information concerning the processing of their personal data, except where federal laws provide otherwise. The Operator must provide this information in an accessible form, without disclosing personal data relating to other subjects unless lawful grounds for such disclosure exist. The Personal Data Law establishes the information to be provided and the procedure for obtaining it;
privacy.block36: — require the Operator to clarify, block or destroy their personal data if it is incomplete, outdated, inaccurate, unlawfully obtained or unnecessary for the stated purpose of processing, and take measures prescribed by law to protect their rights;
privacy.block37: — require prior consent for personal data processing intended to promote goods, works or services on the market;
privacy.block38: — withdraw consent to personal data processing and request that processing cease;
privacy.block39: — challenge unlawful actions or omissions by the Operator when processing their personal data before the competent personal data protection authority or a court;
privacy.block40: — exercise other rights provided by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
privacy.block42: — provide the Operator with reliable information about themselves;
privacy.block43: — notify the Operator of corrections or updates to their personal data.
privacy.block44: 4.3. Persons who provide the Operator with inaccurate information about themselves, or information about another personal data subject without that subject’s consent, are liable under the legislation of the Russian Federation.
privacy.block46: 5.1. Personal data is processed lawfully and fairly.
privacy.block47: 5.2. Processing personal data is limited to achieving specific, predetermined and lawful purposes. Processing incompatible with the purposes for which personal data was collected is prohibited.
privacy.block48: 5.3. Databases containing personal data processed for mutually incompatible purposes must not be combined.
privacy.block49: 5.4. Only personal data relevant to the purposes of processing may be processed.
privacy.block50: 5.5. The content and volume of personal data processed must correspond to the stated purposes. Processing personal data that is excessive for those purposes is prohibited.
privacy.block51: 5.6. Personal data processing must ensure that data is accurate, sufficient and, where necessary, up to date for the purposes of processing. The Operator takes, and/or ensures that others take, the necessary measures to erase or clarify incomplete or inaccurate data.
privacy.block52: 5.7. Personal data must be stored in a form that permits identification of its subject for no longer than necessary for the purposes of processing, unless a retention period is established by federal law or a contract to which the subject is a party, beneficiary or guarantor. Processed personal data is destroyed or depersonalised when the purposes of processing have been achieved or processing is no longer necessary, unless federal law provides otherwise.

privacy.block68: 7.1. Personal data is processed with the consent of the personal data subject.
privacy.block69: 7.2. Personal data processing is necessary to achieve purposes provided for by an international treaty of the Russian Federation or by law, or to exercise functions, powers and duties imposed on the Operator by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
privacy.block70: 7.3. Personal data processing is necessary for the administration of justice or the enforcement of a judicial act or an act of another authority or official that must be enforced under the legislation of the Russian Federation on enforcement proceedings.
privacy.block71: 7.4. Personal data processing is necessary to perform a contract to which the subject is a party, beneficiary or guarantor, or to enter into a contract at the subject’s initiative, or a contract under which the subject will be a beneficiary or guarantor.
privacy.block72: 7.5. Personal data processing is necessary to exercise the rights and legitimate interests of the Operator or third parties, or to achieve socially significant objectives, provided that the rights and freedoms of the personal data subject are not violated.
privacy.block73: 7.6. Personal data to which the subject has granted access to an unlimited number of persons, or requested such access, is processed (publicly available personal data).
privacy.block74: 7.7. Personal data subject to publication or mandatory disclosure under federal law is processed.
privacy.block75: 8. Procedure for collection, storage, transfer and other processing of personal data
privacy.block76: The security of personal data processed by the Operator is ensured through legal, organisational and technical measures necessary to comply fully with applicable personal data protection legislation.
privacy.block77: 8.1. The Operator ensures the safekeeping of personal data and takes all possible measures to prevent access by unauthorised persons.
privacy.block78: 8.2. The User’s personal data will never, under any circumstances, be transferred to third parties, except as required by applicable law or where the subject has consented to such transfer for the performance of obligations under a civil-law contract.
privacy.block79: 8.3. If personal data is inaccurate, the User may update it by notifying the Operator at tenders@htdevelopment.ru with the subject line “Updating personal data”.
privacy.block80: 8.4. The period of personal data processing is determined by the achievement of the purposes for which it was collected, unless a different period is prescribed by a contract or applicable law.
privacy.block81: The User may withdraw consent to personal data processing at any time by emailing the Operator at tenders@htdevelopment.ru with the subject line “Withdrawal of consent to personal data processing”.
privacy.block82: 8.5. Information collected by third-party services, including payment systems, communications providers and other service providers, is stored and processed by those persons (operators) in accordance with their User Agreements and Privacy Policies. The personal data subject and/or those documents. The Operator is not responsible for the actions of third parties, including the service providers specified in this clause.
privacy.block83: 8.6. Prohibitions imposed by the subject on the transfer (other than granting access), processing or conditions of processing (other than obtaining access) of personal data authorised for dissemination do not apply where personal data is processed in state, public or other public-interest contexts specified by the legislation of the Russian Federation.
privacy.block84: 8.7. The Operator ensures the confidentiality of personal data during processing.
privacy.block85: 8.8. The Operator stores personal data in a form that permits identification of its subject for no longer than necessary for the purposes of processing, unless a retention period is prescribed by federal law or a contract to which the subject is a party, beneficiary or guarantor.
privacy.block86: 8.9. Processing may cease when its purposes have been achieved, the subject’s consent has expired, the subject withdraws consent or requests cessation of processing, or unlawful processing is identified.
privacy.block87: 9. Actions performed by the Operator on personal data received
privacy.block88: 9.1. The Operator collects, records, organises, accumulates, stores, clarifies (updates or amends), retrieves, uses, transfers (disseminates, provides or grants access to), depersonalises, blocks, erases and destroys personal data.
privacy.block89: 9.2. The Operator processes personal data automatically, with or without receiving and/or transmitting information over information and telecommunications networks.
privacy.block91: 10.1. Before beginning cross-border transfers of personal data, the Operator must notify the competent personal data protection authority of its intention to make such transfers. This notice must be submitted separately from the notification of intended personal data processing.
privacy.block92: 10.2. Before submitting that notice, the Operator must obtain the relevant information from the foreign public authorities, individuals or legal entities to which personal data is to be transferred.
privacy.block94: The Operator and other persons granted access to personal data must not disclose it to third parties or disseminate it without the subject’s consent, unless federal law provides otherwise.
privacy.block96: 12.1. Users may obtain clarification on any issue concerning the processing of their personal data by contacting the Operator at tenders@htdevelopment.ru.
privacy.block97: 12.2. Any changes to the Operator’s personal data processing policy will be reflected in this document. The Policy remains in force indefinitely until replaced by a new version.
privacy.block98: 12.3. The current version of the Policy is freely available online at hitdev.ru/privacy.
